obligations.title: Deliver the test automation framework (Milestone 1) by 27 December 2026.
Provide documentation and knowledge transfer to the Customer's personnel.
Review each Deliverable and accept it in writing or notify material non-conformity.
Correct non-conformities and resubmit the Deliverable for review.
Provide timely access to systems, information, environments and personnel.
Notify Customer promptly of Customer-caused delays likely to affect the Services.
Notify Customer without undue delay of unauthorised access to or loss of personal data.
Implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures for personal data.
Return or securely delete personal data at Customer's election on termination or expiry.
Promptly deliver all work in progress and Customer materials on termination or expiry.
Hold good-faith senior representative discussions before commencing proceedings over a dispute.
